items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Frist: zwei Wochen nach dem Tag der Zustellung.
items.computation: The letter is dated 18.05.2026 but a scan of the delivery envelope (Zustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) shows the documented actual formal delivery date 'zugestellt am 21.05.2026' (Thursday). Because actual delivery is proven, the statutory deemed-delivery fiction for ordinary post does not apply; the proven date is used as the trigger. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself (21.05.2026) is not counted, so the two-week period begins 22.05.2026. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period stated in weeks ends with the day of the last week bearing the same name as the triggering day, i.e. Thursday 04.06.2026. That day is Fronleichnam, a public holiday in Bayern, so under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG / § 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Friday 05.06.2026.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount (Geldbuße, fee and costs)
items.quote: Zahlung: Gesamtbetrag binnen zwei Wochen ab Rechtskraft auf das unten angegebene Konto (Verwendungszweck: Aktenzeichen).
items.computation: Payment is due two weeks after the decision becomes legally final (Rechtskraft), not from a fixed calendar date. Rechtskraft occurs if no Einspruch is filed within the objection period computed above, i.e. once that period (ending Friday 05.06.2026) lapses unused, so the decision becomes final on Saturday 06.06.2026. Counting two weeks from that day under § 187 Abs. 1 / § 188 Abs. 2 BGB (day of the event not counted, period ends on the corresponding weekday two weeks later) gives Saturday 20.06.2026; since that is a Saturday, § 193 BGB shifts the due date to the next business day, Monday 22.06.2026. This date holds only if no Einspruch is filed by 05.06.2026 — filing an Einspruch prevents Rechtskraft and this payment obligation does not arise on this timeline.

warnings: The payment due date (22.06.2026) is contingent on no Einspruch being filed by 05.06.2026 and on Rechtskraft occurring the day after that period lapses; if an Einspruch is lodged, this payment obligation is suspended and the actual payment deadline will be set later.

The IBAN (DE52 7115 0000 0000 0077 07, BLZ 71150000, Sparkasse) is a valid German account number consistent with the sender's region, but ownership cannot be verified from the letter alone — compare it against any prior correspondence from Stadt Musterau before paying.
